verdict.rationale: Turso's pricing and durability pages list a Free plan alongside paid tiers, and the product is self-serve from signup. A hands-on user says they run both local and hosted Turso and "haven't had to need more than the free tier," which supports the free tier being usable for real projects. missing for 10: documented free-tier quotas and limits (database count, storage, row reads/writes), clear upgrade thresholds, and more than one independent report.
